proposer_change.change: Keep sentences concise (12 to 18 words each) so every 300-word section contains at least 18 distinct sentences and every 50-word slide section contains at least 4 distinct sentences.
proposer_change.why: Round 2 champion train unique_sentences averaged 48.833 against the 146.7 real reference, and Round 4 dropped to 35.333 when writers wrote 29-to-35-word multi-clause sentences.

writer_notes: Writing 12-to-18-word sentences raised train unique_sentences from 48.833 to 65.833 (+17.0 sentences per file) and holdout unique_sentences from 52.0 to 56.5.

In Seed 2027 (5 MB train), writing more paragraphs of shorter sentences caused the writer to use the commercial word margin or revenue once per paragraph across more paragraphs, raising commercial_per_k on bl-002-pdf-5mb_final.pdf to 9.57 and on bl-003-pptx-5mb_final.pptx to 11.36 (mean train commercial_per_k 4.782 vs 2.257 in Round 2).
On the holdout set (Seeds 3101 and 3102), commercial_per_k dropped from 6.298 to 2.325 and unique_sentences rose from 52.0 to 56.5, yielding a +8.279 normalised holdout gain.
